component.name: Koma Paint
component.summary: Paint, ink and draw comics in a studio-style workspace

description.p: Koma Paint is a digital painting and comic studio with a workspace built around how illustrators work: tools and sub tools on the left, layers and navigation on the right, and the canvas in the middle.
Switch between brush variants from the Sub Tool panel, clip, lock and color-code layers straight from the Layers panel, and mix color on a palette that behaves like paint.
Koma Paint is based on Krita. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Krita Foundation.
